A criminal who is hiding from the law — Forajido/a / bandido/a.
The outlaw hid in the hills.
Raise someone to a higher rank — Ascender.
Help something to grow or succeed — Promover / fomentar.
They promoted the film on television.
Not getting enough food to stay healthy — Desnutrido/a / malnutrido/a.
Make something clear with examples — Ilustrar / explicar.
Let me illustrate with a story.
Add pictures to a book — Ilustrar.
Make known something that was secret — Revelar / divulgar.
An event that causes great damage or suffering — Desastre / catástrofe.
Person who removes parts of books or films — Censor(a).
Remove parts that are not allowed — Censurar.
v|Noun: censorship. Careful: censor is not the same as sensor or censure.
The person who did something wrong — Culpable / responsable.
The cause of a problem — Causante.
Damp was the culprit behind the smell.
Young; for young people — Juvenil / infantil.
Childish in a bad way — Infantil / pueril.
A young person, in law — Menor de edad.
The case was heard in a juvenile court.
Say firmly that something must happen — Insistir / empeñarse.
Keep saying something is true — Insistir.
He insists that he saw nothing.
v|Patterns: insist on doing, insist that someone does.
Hard tiring work — Labor / trabajo duro.
Years of toil built the farm.
Work hard or move with difficulty — Bregar / afanarse.
They toiled up the steep hill.
A stupid careless mistake — Metedura de pata / error garrafal.
Sending that email was a blunder.
Make a stupid mistake — Meter la pata.
Move about clumsily — Andar a tientas / tropezar.
Make someone unable to think clearly — Aturdir / atontar.
She walked out in a daze.
Feel or show deep sorrow for someone who has died — Llorar / guardar luto por.
The whole town mourned the teacher.
v|Noun: mourning. Pattern: mourn for or mourn someone.
The pain subsided after an hour.
Sink to a lower level — Bajar / descender.
Hand something over for safekeeping — Encomendar / confiar.
He commended the child to her care.
v|Careful: commend is to praise, recommend is to advise.
Not to be changed — Definitivo/a / inapelable.
Free from a duty others must do — Exento/a.
Free someone from a duty — Eximir / dispensar.
His age exempted him from service.
v|Noun: exemption. Pattern: exempt from something.
Too proud of your looks or ability — Vanidoso/a / presumido/a.
He is vain about his hair.
They made a vain attempt to save the house.
Phrase: in vain, meaning without success. Noun: vanity.
Doing or saying something again — Repetición.
Show something in a picture — Representar / retratar.
Describe something in words — Describir / pintar.
The novel depicts life in the 1930s.
Sure to die one day — Mortal.
She is reading a Russian novel.
Noun: novelty. Careful: a novel is a book, not a soap opera.
Person living in or using a place — Ocupante / inquilino/a.
The occupants left the building safely.
Choose someone for a job or position — Nombrar / designar.
Set a time or place — Fijar / señalar.
We met at the appointed hour.
v|Noun: appointment, which also means a booked meeting.
One of four equal parts — Cuarto / cuarta parte.
A district of a city — Barrio.
We walked through the old quarter.
Rooms to live in, usually plural — Alojamiento / dependencias.
The soldiers returned to their quarters.
Also fifteen minutes: a quarter past three.
The place where something is or happens — Sitio / emplazamiento.
This is the site of the new school.
A place on the internet — Sitio web.
Their site is easy to use.
Careful: site is a place, sight is what you see.
He quoted a line from the poem.
She began with a quote from Cervantes.
Give a price for a job — Presupuestar / cotizar.
A group of lines in a poem or song — Estrofa / verso.
A single line is a line; a verse is the group.
Ideas about what is right and wrong — Moralidad / moral.
They argued about the morality of the war.
Wander with no fixed plan — Vagar / deambular.
Cows roam freely on the hill.
v|Also used of phones: roaming charges.
Make someone come closer or take interest — Atraer.
